alerts.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Llano River at Llano affecting Llano County.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Llano River at Llano.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Moderate lowland flooding makes secondary
roads and low bridges in the flood plain dangerous to motorists
including the low water crossing of Ranch Road 3404/Slab Road near
Kingsland. Equipment should be moved from low docks and boat ties
loosened downstream in Kingsland.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 PM CDT Thursday the stage was 6.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.

will then fall to 6.1 feet late this evening. It will rise above
flood stage just after midnight tonight to 12.8 feet late
tonight. It will then fall below flood stage late tomorrow
morning.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.6
feet on 06/01/2016.

alerts.description:

thunderstorms extending from over St. Paul to 7 miles northeast of
Annaville, or extending from 7 miles north of Sinton to 8 miles north
of Corpus Christi International Airport, moving east at 30 mph.

unsecured objects.

Corpus Christi, Portland, Rockport, Sinton, Port Aransas, Taft,
Woodsboro, Ingleside, Aransas Pass, Odem, Gregory, St. Paul,
Ingleside On The Bay, Bayside, Bonnie View, Corpus Christi North
Beach, Palm Harbor, Papalote, Copano Village and Annaville.

Interstate 37 between mile markers 6 and 13. US Highway 181 between
mile markers 608 and 646. US Highway 77 between mile markers 626 and
656.
